tango.bundle.js is Tango ADB (https://github.com/yume-chan/ya-webadb, MIT,
LICENSE-tango.txt) bundled once with esbuild. Update the bundle and this file
in the same commit.

Packages (all MIT, Simon Chan):
  @yume-chan/adb                 2.6.4
  @yume-chan/adb-daemon-webusb   2.3.2
  @yume-chan/adb-credential-web  2.1.0
  @yume-chan/stream-extra        2.6.1
  @yume-chan/struct              2.3.2   (transitive)
  @yume-chan/async               4.1.3   (transitive)
  @yume-chan/event               2.0.0   (transitive)
  @yume-chan/no-data-view        2.0.0   (transitive)
esbuild 0.28.2

Rebuild (in an empty directory, with tango-entry.js copied in):
  npm init -y
  npm install @yume-chan/adb@2.6.4 @yume-chan/adb-daemon-webusb@2.3.2 \
    @yume-chan/adb-credential-web@2.1.0 @yume-chan/stream-extra@2.6.1 esbuild@0.28.2
  npx esbuild tango-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=eof \
    --target=es2022 --outfile=tango.bundle.js
